differences.what: Cross-cutting, cited not re-described. B1-01/B2-01 shell top bar missing on every pair (main top 24 px against the mock's 44 px at 1440; 108 px against 158 px at 390). B1-04/B2-36 rail 'Not available yet' (Assets, Settings). B2-02 page-local Window: the R112 form on both case tabs; ev-action has none, by design (ruling 14). B1-07/B2-03 14 px prose: the empty, untitled and refusal state sentences and the opened 'What this list is based on' disclosure (pSizes 14px x7), against the mock's 12 px. B1-02/B2-04 tall dark header at 390 on short pages: ev-action refused, 403 and not-found (dark block 286 px, main top 302 px) and every 503 page (main top 397 px). B1-53: raw identifiers (B17-05). B2-21/B3-04 does not apply because EV-LAB-001 is Etc/UTC, so 'UTC' is the Site-local zone and R24 holds. B3-01 does not recur.

B13-01 recurs (mandatory check CONFIRMED). The strip reads 'Scoped to EV · 1 incidents' on ev-work-incidents and 'Scoped to EV · 1 maintenance' (a count with no noun) on ev-work-maintenance, at both widths. Worst case and zero read '5 incidents' and '0 incidents', which are correct. The shared source is siteWorkCases.tsx (B13-01). The EV Actions tab correctly reads '1 action' (R79).
differences.disp: Cite B13-01 (D3 Medium, shared copy fix; cold and EV inherit it).

differences.what: The raw 'c1 · EV_CONNECTOR' Asset label is CONFIRMED in the Maintenance Asset cell (mandatory check): 1 row in positive and 5 rows in worst case, at both widths. It sits directly before the 'UTC and IDs' summary, so the DOM text runs together as 'EV_CONNECTORUTC'. Incidents has no Asset column, so the label does not appear there.
differences.disp: Cite B16-14 / B1-53 (show the connector display name; shared label helper with cold's ' · backup generator' mapping in siteWorkCases.tsx).

differences.what: B13-04 recurs on EV case refusals. A reversed window shows the backticked server text 'This list cannot be shown `from` must be before `to`.'. A 32-day window shows 'The window may span at most 31 days.', which is correct and is the domainActionClient literal. In both cases the strip says 'Count unknown · work source unavailable', the subtabs show '(—)' and the panel footer says 'As of: time not recorded'. On a real 403 the panel correctly says 'No access', but the strip still claims 'work source unavailable', which is false: the problem is access, not the source. B14-02/B16-02 (one '31 days' message for both errors) does NOT recur on the case tabs: each error gets its own text.
differences.disp: Cite B13-04 (D3 Low) and extend its card with the 403 strip wording.

differences.what: domainActionClient window-error check on ev-action: NOT TRIGGERED. The detail read is not window-scoped (ruling 14 keeps the query and gives no Window control). So a reversed window and a 32-day window both render the CURRENT plan with no notice, and the invalid from/to is carried onto the page's own Verification tab link. EV_ACTION_PRESENTATION.windowQuery: true (evWorkPresentation.ts:111; declared at DomainActionVerification.tsx:64) is never read anywhere in frontend/src. It is a dead field: the window passes through SiteAnalyticsFrames.tsx:1641 instead.
differences.disp: D3 Low: either validate the carried window (invalidScope) and drop it from the page's own links, or rule that the detail ignores it. Remove or wire the unread windowQuery field. Not a data-honesty defect.

differences.what: Raw identifiers. Each case row has a 'UTC and IDs' disclosure (B13-05) holding Case ID, Version ID and Activity record UUIDs in their own scrollers. The linked Action is labelled 'Action ab9b6724' (a UUID prefix), although its code ACT-000001 is on the Actions tab. The basis disclosure prints 'Linked evidence COMPLETE' (raw enum) and 'List fence sha256:…'. The incident row says 'Source of cited records · Generated test data' while the case has an empty citation set.
differences.disp: Cite B1-53 / B13-05 / B16-05. Using the Action code for the link label: D3 Low.

differences.what: Non-loaded ev-action states. These use the untitled R110 panel, with the h1 falling back to 'Action' and the breadcrumb losing the ACT code. An invalid known_at gives 'EV work unavailable · 'known_at' must be one UTC instant no later than the read time. · Retry', which is the server literal with quoted field name, an 'EV work' heading on an Action page, and a Retry that cannot succeed. A 403 gives 'EV work unavailable · No access to Site 'EV-LAB-001'. · Retry'. A 404, or a cutoff before the Action existed, gives 'Action was not found at this site.', which is correct. The 390 dark header block is 286 px (B1-02).
differences.disp: Same pattern as B13-03/B13-04/B14-01: D3 Low (Action-specific refusal heading, plain copy, no Retry for an input error or a 403). R110 verified as built.

differences.what: Batch 4/5 Action chrome is RESOLVED on EV. Breadcrumb: 'Actions › ACT-000001 › Verification · site: EV charging lab' (mock: 'Actions › ACT-061 › Verification · site: Depot Charging Hub'). There is no Site tab row. The 'Open site' button is present. 'Verification' is the only tab, and the rail selects Actions (R69). So B4-03, B4-04, B4-05 and B5-01 do not recur, and B4-07 does not apply because there is no Execution tab. Panel title, columns, the three criteria rows and the closing notice match the mock text exactly. Plan panel: 248/243 px (1.02x) at 1440 and 406/401 px (1.01x) at 390. Also verified: R109 (160-character title and owner wrap, worst-case page 1141 px at 390), R110, R111 (stored name) and R80 (historical 'Read as of … Later work may differ.'). The remaining differences are B1-01 and the stored names/codes.
differences.disp: (a) Verified: R69/R80/R109/R110/R111 and R113. R111's status in the register still reads 'planned' and should be updated to built.

differences.what: Untabbed ev-action section addresses. '/actions/<id>/overview' falls back to the W1 'No such Action section' page with W1 chrome: the Findings-rooted breadcrumb 'Sites / EV charging lab / Findings / Action', the Site tab row with Findings current, and the subtitle 'EV charging lab · an action raised from a finding'. So B4-03, B4-04 and B4-06 recur on that address. '/execution', '/history', '/plan' and '/evidence' silently render the Verification page with the URL unchanged. No in-app link reaches these addresses. Source: SiteAnalyticsFrames.tsx:1630-1647 (W1_ONLY_SECTIONS routed to the domain page; 'overview' is excluded).
differences.disp: D3 Low, shared with cold (batch 15 to confirm): send any unknown or W1 section on a domain Action to /verification or to a domain-styled not-served panel.

differences.what: B4-19 does not recur: there is no event-history list on EV Actions, and no pair logged a console error (84 pairs plus 20 link captures). The first links run hit a Vite dependency re-optimisation ('Invalid hook call', blank page). That was a dev-server artifact: it was rerun on a fresh Vite and passed. It is not a product defect.

R112 is verified built on both case tabs: the form sits after the subtabs and before the strip, one 33 px row at 1440 and stacked to 136 px at 390, labelled 'From (UTC)' / 'To (UTC, exclusive)'. The register status still reads 'planned'. R113 / ruling 71 is verified: the case-row Action link carries the selected from/to and no known_at when none was selected. A known_at-carrying row link was not captured, because the index-known-at cutoff precedes the cases. The strip's 'Manage in Incidents →' / 'Manage in Maintenance →' links go to /incidents and /maintenance with the read's known_at. The walkthrough API answers those global routes with 503 WORK_STORE_UNAVAILABLE, so the global page shows 'Work records could not be read'. Whether the destination lists the EV cases (B14-14) is therefore unverified.
differences.disp: (a) R112/R113. Update R112's status to built. Global destination: producer scope note.

differences.what: Strip and notice copy differ from the mock. B13-16 recurs: the notice drops the mock's 'New work starts from the global create flow with this site filled in.' (R35, no create flow). The strip reads 'Scoped to EV', using shortName() of the stored 'EV charging lab'; the mock reads 'Scoped to Depot'. 'EV' reads like the domain rather than the Site. The populated tables (1 or 5 rows) replace the mock's zero state; zero mode matches the mock exactly (title, empty heading and body, 1.02-1.07x).
differences.disp: Cite B13-16 (extend R35). 'Scoped to EV': (b) D4 under R111, or D3 Low to use the full stored name.

differences.what: Lifecycle coverage. The producer offers only Action 'Open', Incident and request 'Open', and record outcome 'Unverified'. CANCELLED and VERIFICATION_WINDOW case states, closed or completed cases, and any later Action state are NOT producible by w504. VERIFICATION_WINDOW is unreachable in W4 anyway (W4-01 spec: OPEN_VERIFICATION reserved, 409). Static check only: siteWorkCases.tsx:268-281 labels them 'Verification window' (blue tone) and 'Cancelled' (neutral), which matches the W4-01 chip-tone table; WorkRequestOverview.tsx:22 adds 'Cancelled · work stopped'. The carried Architect item stays OPEN, with no visual evidence.
differences.disp: Architect: decide whether a reviewed producer mode should issue CANCEL (reachable) for a capture, and rule VERIFICATION_WINDOW (W6-01b P-B1-11). The capture is blocked until then.

differences.what: Heights and caps (rulings 25/26/50/70), measured. Populated 1-row case panels: 212/195 px at 1440 and 201/216 px at 390, shorter than the mock's zero panel (316/296 px). Zero, historical and no-window panels: 1.02-1.07x. Worst case: five 160-character rows, 502 px at 1440 and 445 px at 390 against the 650/650 cap; pages 1000/1140 px against 1600/2000; two-line clamp with 'Read full text' (10 disclosures). Refused panels 145/153-174 px against 360/590. ev-action: plan 248/406 px against 360/590, worst-case page 1000/1141 px against 1500/1900, strip about 115 px at 390 by screenshot (not DOM-measured) against 140/200, missing-intent panel 103/126 px and untitled panel 63-181 px against 360/590. All-open is exempt: incidents 783/1023 px (worst case 1998/2206), maintenance 827/1050 px (worst case 2216/2342); UUIDs sit in their own scrollers (218 px in 99-180 px). Page horizontal overflow is 0 everywhere. At 390 the table scrolls inside its panel (720/760 px in 324 px) with a 'Scroll the table for more columns →' hint, and the Site tab row scrolls (521 px in 358 px), hiding Overview (B13-18/B4-04).
differences.disp: Accept under the ruled caps. Cite B13-18 for the 390 tab row.
